name: Primalist Volcanic Blast: resolved critical damage, rank percentages and nearby targets
contract: Rank one repeats 20% of completed Physical or Nature critical damage as a single noncritical Fire hit
on the target and nearby enemies. Rank two copies 40% with its original DBC 90% proc chance, sampled
over 160 funded ordinary critical casts. Baseline, Fire critical hits, normal hits, removal and distant
targets do not trigger it. Each normal-hit control explicitly disables the native physical-spell crit

steps.label: Each ordinary trial waits through the effective cast time
The normal-hit control cannot critically strike
